definitions.gloss: nearest; closest (especially of a station, store, or facility)
definitions.explanation: The one geographically closest to a given location, usually one's home, workplace, or current spot. Almost always used attributively before a noun, especially {駅|えき} (station).

examples.japanese: {最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧です。
examples.english: It's a five-minute walk to the nearest convenience store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: For details, please contact your nearest service counter.

notes:
Almost exclusively used attributively, in the pattern {最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Note the irregular reading もより (not さいき or さい⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧). One of the most useful directions/location words for daily life in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧: nearest station
- {最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧: nearest convenience store
- {最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧: nearest store/branch
- {最寄|もよ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧: nearest police box
- {最寄|もよ}り{駅|えき}: home station; nearest station (as a noun compound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧: the closest — more conversational, can describe distance generally
- {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: nearby — looser; doesn't specifically mean the nearest one
